title: Glaciology
description: Ice flows. Under its own weight a glacier creeps downhill like very slow toffee, faster the harder it is pushed (Glen's law), and every year of snow it buries stays in it as a layer, with bubbles of that year's air. Unlocks the Ice Core Drill.

puzzle.goal: Glacier ice deforms at a strain rate that grows as a power of the shear stress τ on it, with a rate factor A that depends on temperature (Glen's flow law). Write ε, the strain rate.
puzzle.name: Glen's flow law
puzzle.ask: Find ε in 1/s: A = @{A} Pa⁻ⁿ/s, τ = @{τ} Pa, n = @{n}.
puzzle.method: Measured on glaciers and in the laboratory: doubling the stress makes ice flow about eight times faster (n ≈ 3).
